outcome_rule: Each axis is an integer from -3 to +3. Composite is the arithmetic mean of all four axes, recorded after the target day without viewing channel scores.
class_rule: negative if composite <= -0.5; neutral if -0.5 < composite < 0.5; positive if composite >= 0.5
error: predicted class differs from observed class; absolute error is abs(prediction_score - outcome_composite)
miss: prediction absent before target-day start, outcome absent after close, invalid provenance, unblinded capture, or contract violation; misses are excluded from accuracy and included in coverage denominator

channel_scope.expert_pdf: independent author forecast; evaluated as a forecast, not as ground truth
channel_scope.frozen_engine: expert-imitation model; evaluated separately and never described as independent of expert labels
channel_scope.tanita_image: separate shadow decoder; score_effect remains 0 until promotion gate passes
